text: Step inside the Neutron test campaign with the Thrust Module and Stage 2 at Launch Complex 3 🚀 ⚙️ These campaigns are all about verifying the hardware, the ground systems, and operational procedures, bringing Neutron one step closer to flight.

ESCAPADE’s view of Earth as Blue and Gold pass by on their way to Mars. Two weeks ago, the Rocket Lab-built spacecraft completed powered flybys of Earth two days apart. About three hours later, one spacecraft captured this farewell view of our planet from 38,500 miles away. Here are a few images from the next stage of the escapade mars mission for NASA and ucbssl. 📸 NASA/ucbssl/NAU/RocketLab

ESCAPADE’s view of Earth as it passes by on the way to Mars. Two weeks ago, the Rocket Lab-built Blue & Gold spacecraft completed powered flybys of Earth two days apart, and are now on their way to Mars. Here are a few images from this next stage of the escapade mars mission for NASA and ucbssl. 📸 NASA/ucbssl/NAU/RocketLab

Six launch pads in both hemispheres provides our customers with the means to reach space from multiple points on Earth, just hours apart. We started with the world's first private orbital launch site on the Mahia Peninsula in New Zealand, followed with two launch sites in the United States, and have begun ground works for more sites in Alaska. Breaking bottlenecks with regular, reliable and responsive launch for orbital and suborbital missions - one Launch Complex at a time.
